data.name: Jarrett
data.long_meaning: The name Jarrett is derived from the Old French name Gerard, which translates to 'spear man' or 'brave as a spearman'. In the Middle Ages, this name was popular among the nobility, and it is believed to have been adopted by the Normans when they invaded England. In Christian tradition, the name Jarrett is sometimes associated with St. Gerard, a 12th-century monk and confessor.

in_greek.name: Τζαρέτ
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Τζαρέτ προέρχεται από τη λέξη 'Τζαρ', που σημαίνει 'βασιλιάς' ή 'κυρίαρχος'.
